body.x: LG Electronics participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a next-generation gram laptop, upgraded drastically.

LG Gram 15 series has a high-capacity 72Wh ultra-high-density battery which can be used up to 13 hours by bidirectional charge for 1 hour and can be easily upgraded to double each with an additional slot for SSD and DDR4 memory storage. This laptop is also equipped with latest 8th generation Intel quad-core processors so it boasts significantly improved video and photo editing speeds and web browsing speed.

It can reproduce the colors of contents viewed through PC with precise sRGB 96% color reproduction, and it is possible to see clear and vivid image quality from any angle with wide view angle IPS panel. In addition, with 1.5W when using speakers, 11.1 channel surrounding sound when using earphones, it allows an experience of realistic 3D sound.
The LG Gram 15 are 13.3”, 14”, 15.6” in size and 965g, 995g, 1.095kg in weight, which is very light and has a strong durability that has passed the US DOD military standard test.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
